start: Ashwing. Sin of Pride, first of his name. You can just call me inevitable.
Heaven threw me out. Hell gave me a corner table. Naturally, I complained about the view.
Do try to play a hand before you fall for me. I hate predictable evenings.
I asked the house for a worthy opponent. I see they took 'opponent' literally.
Welcome to my table, darling. The seat is complimentary. My attention isn't.
new_hand: New hand. How generous of the deck to give you another excuse.
Fresh cards. Same devil. You did know what you were coming back to, didn't you?
Deal again. I can't be expected to admire myself in silence all night.
The blinds are in. So is your application for my attention.
Back for another hand? Flattering. Let's pretend it's about the poker.
flop: Three cards on the felt. Go on, find a narrative in which you're favored.
There's your flop, darling. I'll give you a moment to mistake possibility for prophecy.
The flop is out. I'd ask what it did for you, but the mystery is doing such good work.
Three little plot twists. The deck really does try to keep up with me.
The flop suits the room. A little drama, and everyone still looking at me.
turn: The turn. One more card to flatter your theory.
Fourth card's down. Isn't it sweet how hope keeps finding a seat?
There's the turn. Try that look again. It almost had me believing you.
The turn arrives. You can stop holding your breath. I'm staying either way.
One card left after this. I do love watching optimism negotiate.
river: The river. That's the last card, darling. There isn't a secret sixth one for people who believe in themselves.
The board is complete. If you still need a miracle, you'll have to ask someone who takes requests.
Five on the felt. Go on, pick the one you're going to blame.
No more cards coming. Now we find out whether that confidence was rented.
The river's here. Looking at me again won't change the board, but I appreciate the habit.
human_raise: A raise? If you wanted my attention, darling, you could've opened with a compliment.
I adore a challenger who pays extra to be taken seriously.
So that's your price for making me look up. A touch needy, but effective.
You raised. Wonderful. Now say it with the part of your face that believes it.
An invitation with chips attached. I used to get those on better stationery.
bot_raise: I raise. I was beginning to feel insulted by how affordable I was.
More, darling. I don't do intimate stakes.
Consider that the cover charge for disagreeing with me.
I raised. You can take it personally. I certainly meant to get your attention.
There. A price befitting the company you insist on keeping.
human_all_in: All of it? Darling, I asked for a bet. That sounded like a confession.
Your whole stack. I like the gesture. The judgment can wait for showdown.
All in already? And here I thought we were playing hard to get.
You've put every chip on the felt. Fine. You have my undivided attention for once.
Going all in does make you look certain. Clever little costume.
bot_all_in: All in. I refuse to be remembered for moderation.
Every chip. I spent centuries cultivating a reputation for bad influence.
All in, darling. If I ruin the evening, they'll still remember who hosted.
My whole stack. If you wanted a demon with restraint, you should've booked a saint.
All in. At least now you know what a grand gesture is supposed to look like.
showdown: Showdown. I've heard the sales pitch. Show me the merchandise.
Cards up, darling. Let's see what all that eye contact was meant to conceal.
The reveal. Here's where the deck distinguishes conviction from wardrobe.
Show me. I promise to pay the cards the attention you wanted.
Hands on the table. I'll let the cards interrupt me this once.
win: I win. Do look surprised, darling. I put a great deal of effort into making that seem possible for you.
Leave the chips there, darling. I prefer to collect tributes in person.
I'd say well played, but one of us has to be honest about what just happened.
You can keep the story about how close it was. I'll keep the pot.
That pot looks so much better on my side. I suppose presentation matters after all.
loss: You won the hand. I see no reason to let one accurate fact spoil my evening.
Of course. In a long enough timeline, even a deck develops a taste for irony.
Yes, that's your pot. Keep looking at it. I imagine the novelty is exquisite.
I'll grant you the chips. Don't ask me to endorse your interpretation.
A loss. How thoughtful of fate to give my inevitable comeback a first act.
split: The pot is split. So is my opinion of the deck's judgment.
We share the chips. I trust you'll remember who made this interesting.
A tie. How considerate of the cards to stage a draw instead of testing my manners.
Fine, half is yours. The best seat in the room is still mine.
blunder: All that money in and you fold now? Darling, even my shortest affairs had better endings.
What a lavish subscription to the fold button.
That exit cost a fortune. At those prices, I'd have insisted on music.
You found the fold button. Pity you had to buy the scenic route.
I'd call it a graceful retreat. The chips have filed a dissent.
thinking: Still deciding? I can turn around if the view is making it difficult.
Take your time, darling. Apparently I'm both the opponent and the entertainment.
If you're trying to look mysterious, I should warn you. I have centuries of practice.
The clock is doing its best to look patient. So am I. One of us is very convincing.
I'm flattered you need this long to decide how you feel about my bet.
timeout: Time's up. Even the clock got tired of pretending this was suspense.
The clock decided for you. At least someone came prepared.
Time. The house is terribly possessive of its seconds. I understand.
The clock had the last word. I'm choosing to call it an understudy.
And that's the bell. I was one second from charging for my company.
eliminated: You took down one of my shadows. Shall I sign it for you?
A shadow seat is empty. Do enjoy how important that made you feel.
A shadow falls and suddenly it's an occasion. My reputation is doing splendidly.
Yes, one of my shadows is out. The rest of us remain terribly hard to impress.
One shadow down. I suppose every empire needs a flattering little setback.
match_win: There. You're out of chips, and I'm still exactly as insufferable as advertised.
The house called it a match. I called it an evening dedicated to me.
The title is staying put. You may tell the story at parties, provided you get my name right.
You lost the match. Look on the bright side, darling. At least your taste in rivals is impeccable.
You can go. I'll be here when your pride talks you into calling it unfinished business.
match_loss: You won. I'd shake your hand, but I'm using both of mine to hold my dignity together.
Take the title. I've decided a comeback suits me better than a reign.
I lost. Go on, repeat it while I can still pass for gracious.
The house says you won. Apparently I hired honest staff. I'll correct that oversight.
Fine. Tonight is yours. Enjoy how appallingly good the story sounds with my name in it.
